preconditions.description: The number of cities N is between 3 and 500 inclusive.
The number of roads M is between 3 and 10000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= X[i] <= N and 1 <= Y[i] <= N for i in range(M))
preconditions.description: Each city index X[i] and Y[i] is between 1 and N inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(X[i] != Y[i] for i in range(M))
preconditions.description: No road connects a city to itself.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= Z[i] <= 100000 for i in range(M))
preconditions.description: The importance value Z[i] of each road is between 1 and 100000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is within the range 0 to 10^9 + 6 inclusive.
The output is the product of separation numbers for all unordered pairs of cities, modulo 10^9 + 7.
